title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: "Our Journey to Sinai" (Class # 14)

chapters.title: Moving from control to trust
chapters.about: Perfectionism, control, and living as a conduit for Hashem

chapters.title: A story of self-respect
chapters.about: A conflict between the teacher's daughters and the lesson of self-respect

chapters.title: People as catalysts for growth
chapters.about: Viewing difficult people as opportunities to connect to Hashem

chapters.title: The story of Iris
chapters.about: Overcoming rigid habits and making peace with one's own desires

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses the importance of self-respect and how our reactions to external triggers can reveal areas where we are not honoring our own needs. She illustrates this through stories about her daughter and a friend named Iris, explaining how shifting from a mindset of control to one of trust and acceptance allows us to become better conduits for Hashem. The class emphasizes that challenging interactions with others are opportunities for personal growth and self-awareness.
questions: How can I stop feeling triggered by the behavior of others?
What does it mean to be a conduit for Hashem?
How can I distinguish between my authentic self and my rigid habits?
Why do I feel guilty when I prioritize my own needs?
How can I handle difficult family dynamics with more trust and less control?
